claims.sourceText: AEROSPACE TECHNICAL INTELLIGENCE CENTER, Department of the Air Force Organizational Histories compilation, created 10 December 2025, sourced to the Air Force Historical Research Agency, https://www.usafunithistory.com/PDF/A-E/AEROSPACE%20TECHNICAL%20INTELLIGENCE%20CENTER.pdf
claims.text: The lineage is a discontinuation and a new constitution, not a renaming: 'Air Technical Intelligence Center established 21 May 1951; redesignated Aerospace Technical Intelligence Center, 21 September 1959; discontinued 1 July 1961. Foreign Technology Division constituted, activated, and organized 1 July 1961', and 'On 1 July 1961, the organization was inactivated and the mission and resources absorbed by the Foreign Technology Division (FTD)'. Tier 2 because the compilation carrying this text is a private site citing the Air Force Historical Research Agency, and AFHRA's own pages return HTTP 403 from this environment.

claims.text: The Air Force organizational-history lineage records a discontinuation and a new constitution rather than a renaming: 'Air Technical Intelligence Center established 21 May 1951; redesignated Aerospace Technical Intelligence Center, 21 September 1959; discontinued 1 July 1961. Foreign Technology Division constituted, activated, and organized 1 July 1961', with the mission and resources absorbed by FTD on that date. Tier 2 because the compilation carrying this text is a private site citing the Air Force Historical Research Agency, and AFHRA's own page returns HTTP 403 from this environment.

edges.label: ATIC discontinued 1 July 1961; FTD constituted the same day and absorbed its mission
edges.note: The lineage record says ATIC was redesignated Aerospace Technical Intelligence Center in 1959 and discontinued on 1 July 1961, with the mission and resources absorbed by the newly constituted Foreign Technology Division, so this is a succession rather than the renaming the board's prose describes.
